name: MAX98357A I2S amplifier (3 W class D)
description: Digital audio in (I2S), speaker out: plays the samples the board sends over I2S on a 4 or 8 Ω speaker wired to its + / - terminals. Generic audio output for any sound: tones, clips, streamed audio. Wire BCLK, LRC (word select) and DIN to three free GPIOs and pass them to the I2S driver. SD sets the channel: high or floating = left (mono boards: tie to VIN), GND = shutdown.

pins.label: LRC
pins.description: Word select (left / right clock). To the board's I2S WS pin.

pins.label: BCLK
pins.description: Bit clock. To the board's I2S BCLK pin.

pins.label: DIN
pins.description: Serial audio data in. To the board's I2S data out pin.

pins.label: GAIN
pins.description: Gain: floating 9 dB, GND 12 dB, VIN 6 dB (100 kΩ to GND 15 dB, to VIN 3 dB).

pins.label: SD
pins.description: Shutdown and channel: above 1.4 V left, 0.77 to 1.4 V right, 0.16 to 0.77 V (L+R)/2, below 0.16 V off. Floating = left (internal pull-up).

pins.label: Vin
pins.description: 2.5 to 5.5 V. 5 V gives the most power.
Speaker +. Bridge-tied output: never connect either speaker terminal to GND.

props.label: Gain (GAIN pin)
props.description: Set by how the GAIN pin is strapped (floating = 9 dB). Used when the GAIN pin is not wired.

bindings.description: Audio above -60 dBFS arrived in the last 100 ms.
Output loudness 0..1 (RMS of the last block, after gain).
Sample rate of the incoming I2S stream (Hz).
RMS voltage across the speaker terminals (V).
